_comment: Registry of the manuscript versions and of what each one added to the results. The 'tidy_tables' counts and the 'identical_results_to' fields are not editorial claims: they come from hashing every CSV in each version's technical/data folder and comparing them pairwise (see scripts/audit_versions.py). Pages are generated from this file, so the site cannot drift from the audit.

audit.method: SHA-256 of every tidy result table in <version>/technical/data, compared pairwise between consecutive versions.
audit.finding: No result table ever changed between versions 05 and 10. Every table common to two consecutive versions is byte-identical; versions only ever add tables. What changes from version 07 onwards is how the same numbers are laid out into figures.

versions.title: Initial manuscript
versions.what: First complete manuscript, a single Spanish document. Five figures (trends, episodes, territory, ecological, trajectories) and five tables built by make_all.py against the aggregates of output_files/consolidacion.
versions.results: Own table set (tabla1-tabla5), not comparable line by line with the later series: the observation window is 2017-2024 and the case definition had not yet been split into the two variants.

versions.title: Full corpus
versions.what: Twelve documents: two case definitions (with and without Rett) x two languages x three products (combined manuscript, standalone appendix, article only), built by pipeline/10_manuscript.py.
versions.results: The reference corpus against which any figure in the later versions is audited: 5 article plates and 7 article tables, plus 54 supplementary plates and 125 supplementary tables.

versions.title: Discarded editorial selection
versions.what: Two editable manuscripts (EN and ES) built by build_final.py. The selection was discarded and the DOCX files no longer exist; build_verification.json is the only record.
versions.results: Nothing to reproduce: six figures were produced and no result table. Listed here so the numbering of the series stays complete.

versions.title: Submission package
versions.what: Article EN, appendix EN and a working ES version, restricted to a single case definition (without Rett), built by journal/build_journal.py.
versions.results: Editorial selection of the corpus of version 02: six display items in the body (four figures and two tables) and the rest moved to the appendix. No number is recalculated.

versions.title: Scientific revision
versions.what: Manuscript and supplement rewritten from the submission package. First version with the tidy result tables kept as a separate, auditable folder.
versions.results: Baseline of the modern series: 48 tidy tables.

versions.title: Expanded revision
versions.what: Extended methods and results in the supplement, for the team's review.
versions.results: Adds 11 tidy tables to version 05 (clinical chapters, expanded age distribution, assisted referrals, dataflow provenance and expanded regional endpoints). The 48 tables of version 05 are unchanged, byte for byte.

versions.title: Bilingual editorial revision
versions.what: Acronyms defined and figure titles moved into the captions. The figures are renamed and restructured into the Figure_1 to Figure_5 series.
versions.results: Adds 3 tidy tables to version 06 (the three Figure5 endpoint tables). The 59 earlier tables are unchanged.

versions.folder_note: The folder on disk carries a longer historical suffix. It was not renamed because its own build scripts assert their folder name before running, and the version folders are not part of the repository.
versions.title: Editorial adjustment
versions.what: Body reduced to four figures and two tables, with 23 equations moved to the supplement. Figure_5 becomes supplementary Figure_S6.
versions.results: No new result: its 62 tidy tables are byte-identical to those of version 07. The change is entirely one of layout, so this version shares a page with version 07.

versions.title: Clinical revision
versions.what: Hospital burden and repeated contact added, the F80-F89 block introduced as a comparator and the territorial analysis moved to the appendix.
versions.results: Adds 9 tidy tables to version 07 (length of stay, multiplicity, readmission, case-definition subcodes and variant rates, F80-F89 denominators and counts). The 62 earlier tables are unchanged.

versions.title: Panel layout
versions.what: Results reorganised around four panel figures, with nine supplementary figures. The version's own record states it recalculated no figure.
versions.results: No new result: its 71 tidy tables are byte-identical to those of version 09. This is the layout the site reproduces, because its plates are the ones rebuilt at render time from the public tables.
